title: 箱庭クラフト [Hakoniwa Craft]
description: Let’s build a beautiful, orderly miniature world together!
body:
Welcome to Hakoniwa Craft, a creative and community-driven survival server running on the latest Minecraft version 1.21.4.
Our server core philosophy is nurturing a beautiful world together. We offer a rich survival experience enhanced with mcMMO, a player-driven economy, and a unique Architect Rank System that rewards talented builders with special perks and increased entity limits.
Whether you are a master architect or a casual explorer, you will find a home here. We prioritize a friendly atmosphere and fair play, supported by custom-developed plugins and active moderation.
Key features include our stable economy where you can earn currency through jobs and trade at the admin shop. Advance your rank from apprentice to master architect and help us cultivate this beautiful miniature garden world. Join Hakoniwa Craft today and start your new adventure.
